summary.text: Conrad Cable, a Democratic farmer from Union Parish, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Louisiana's 4th Congressional District to Mike Johnson.
He describes himself as a first-generation farmer who runs a vegetable farm with his brother in Marion.

paragraphs.text: Cable grew up in Union Parish and has lived in Louisiana his entire life, and his campaign website says he grew up in the town of Marion.
He graduated from Ouachita Christian School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Louisiana at Monroe in 2017.
After losing his job during COVID, he and his brother built a small farm in Union Parish, and he now runs a vegetable farm with his brother in Marion.
He says his decision to run was shaped by the closure of his childhood school after funding cuts and by the Citizens United ruling.
During the campaign, he emphasized Medicare for All, food security and campaign-finance reform.
He received 23.0% of the vote to Mike Johnson's 58.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
